question: What is the role of the finance minister under the FRBM Act?

options.text: To present fiscal policy statements to Parliament

solution:
The correct answer is __**To present fiscal policy statements to Parliament**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Finance Minister is mandated under the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act, 2003, to present fiscal policy statements to Parliament for ensuring transparency and accountability in fiscal management.
 
• The key fiscal policy statements include the Medium-Term Fiscal Policy Statement, the Fiscal Policy Strategy Statement, and the Macro-Economic Framework Statement.
 
• The objective of these statements is to provide a roadmap for fiscal consolidation, ensuring fiscal discipline and long-term economic stability.
 
• The Finance Minister also reviews compliance with the targets set under the FRBM Act, such as fiscal deficit and revenue deficit, and reports deviations, if any, to Parliament.
 
• These statements aim to keep fiscal management aligned with the principles of prudence, sustainability, and intergenerational equity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act:**

 
 
• It was enacted in 2003 to institutionalize financial discipline and reduce fiscal deficits in India.
 
• The Act sets limits on the fiscal deficit and public debt of the government, aiming to achieve a balanced budget over time.
 
• It was amended in 2018 to include a fiscal deficit target of 3% of GDP by March 2021.
 
 
 
• **Fiscal Deficit:**
 
 
• It is the difference between total government expenditure and its total revenue (excluding borrowings).
 
• High fiscal deficits can lead to inflationary pressures, whereas low deficits ensure fiscal sustainability.
 
 
 
• **Revenue Deficit:**
 
 
• The revenue deficit refers to the excess of the government's revenue expenditure over revenue receipts.
 
• A high revenue deficit indicates that the government is borrowing to meet its operational expenses.
 
 
 
• **Medium-Term Fiscal Policy Statement:**
 
 
• It projects three-year rolling targets for key fiscal indicators like revenue deficit, fiscal deficit, and debt levels.
 
 
 
• **Fiscal Policy Strategy Statement:**
 
 
• It outlines the government's strategy to achieve fiscal objectives and manage public finances.
